desc: Read input integers $W, H, L, R, D, U$.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to $W+H+5$ for $O(1)$ binomial coefficient queries.
Compute the total number of paths in the full grid $G$ using the derived formula.
Calculate the number of bad paths entering from the left boundary of $F$ by summing products of path counts ending at $(L-1, y)$ and starting at $(L, y)$.
Calculate the number of bad paths entering from the bottom boundary of $F$ by summing products of path counts ending at $(x, D-1)$ and starting at $(x, D)$.
Sum these bad path counts and subtract from the total paths to get the answer.
Fix bounds checking for T(nx, ny) to return 0 if neighbors are outside the grid $[0, W] \times [0, H]$.
Correct the tridiagonal system coefficients: set diagonal to 1 and off-diagonals to -1, as $B[i] - B[i-1] - B[i+1] = C[i]$.
Re-run and verify against sample cases.
